description: Switch what the layout window shows – for screen recordings and for checking a page by eye: guides_shown (Hilfslinien), frame_edges_shown (Rahmenkanten), text_threads_shown (Textverkettungen), baseline_grid_shown (Grundlinienraster), document_grid_shown (Dokumentraster), hidden_characters_shown (verborgene Zeichen), screen_mode normal, preview (Vorschau), bleed (Anschnitt), slug (Infobereich) or presentation. At least one; what is omitted stays. Changes only the view, never the content; InDesign stores the view settings with the document. screen_mode needs a layout window (invalid_state, details.code "no_layout_window", for a document opened with show_window false). Returns has_window, view_options with every value read back and previous (the values before, to restore them later).

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

screen_mode.description: Screen mode (Bildschirmmodus): normal, preview, bleed, slug or presentation.

name: set_view_options
title: Set view options
